offering_description.value: THOR Industries makes travel trailers, fifth-wheel trailers, motorhomes and camper vans for recreational travelers and sells them primarily through independent dealers. It also makes appliances, systems and aluminum components for vehicle manufacturers and the aftermarket. Its European businesses offer motorhome rentals through partner networks.

primary_products.value: Travel trailers and caravans; fifth-wheel trailers; motorhomes and camper vans; RV appliances and systems; aluminum extrusions

primary_services.value: Motorhome rentals; paid RV repairs and upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent RV dealers, vehicle manufacturers, and aftermarket parts distributors; B2C: Recreational travelers who buy or rent RVs, and owners who buy parts or repairs

end_markets.value: Recreational vehicles; camping and leisure travel; RV aftermarket; industrial fabrication

revenue_model.value: product sales: Finished RVs, appliances, vehicle systems, and aluminum components; rental or leasing: Short-term motorhome rentals; service fees: Paid RV repairs and upgrades
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds finished RVs from chassis and other components for independent dealers; component supplier: Makes appliances, vehicle systems and aluminum extrusions for manufacturers and aftermarket buyers; service provider: Arranges motorhome rentals through partner networks and provides paid repairs and upgrades for RV owners
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, Canada and Europe, with sales in other markets

specialization.value: related lines: Towable and motorized RVs, RV appliances and components, aluminum extrusions, rentals and repairs

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent RV dealerships and aftermarket parts distributors; direct sales: Supply relationships with RV manufacturers and other industrial buyers; partners / resellers: Motorhome rental partners in Europe; own locations: Factory service centers for repairs and upgrades
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: European vehicle type approval and U.S. NHTSA vehicle safety, certification and recall rules
